member.name: M:OWSPublicAPI.Controllers.UsersController.CreateCharacter(OWSPublicAPI.Requests.Users.CreateCharacterRequest)
member.remarks: Create a new Character and attach it to the User referenced by the UserSessionGUID. ClassName is the name of the Class you setup in the management console (from the Characters tab). Classes are meant to be default values for creating characters. The purpose is to ensure that players are not able to hack their starting stats. This is needed because Characters are created from and unsecure UE client that has not connected to a UE server yet.

member.name: M:OWSPublicAPI.Controllers.UsersController.CreateCharacterUsingDefaultCharacterValues(OWSPublicAPI.DTOs.CreateCharacterUsingDefaultCharacterValuesDTO)
member.summary: Creates a new Character using DefaultCharacterValues.
member.remarks: Create a new Character and attach it to the User referenced by the UserSessionGUID. DefaultSetName is the name of the DefaultCharacterValues row. DefaultCharacterValues and DefaultCustomCharacterData are used to set the default starting values for new characters. The purpose is to ensure that players are not able to hack their starting stats. This is needed because Characters are created from and unsecure UE client that has not connected to a UE server yet.

member.name: M:OWSPublicAPI.Controllers.UsersController.GetAllCharacters(OWSPublicAPI.Requests.Users.GetAllCharactersRequest)
member.summary: Get All Characters for a specified User.
member.remarks: Send in a UserSessionGUID to specify which User to get all Characters for. Use GetAllCharactersWithCustomData to also get all attached custom data with the same API call. Users may have zero or more Characters.

member.name: M:OWSPublicAPI.Controllers.UsersController.GetServerToConnectTo(OWSPublicAPI.Requests.Users.GetServerToConnectToRequest)
member.summary: Gets the server to connect to for a specific character or zone name.
member.remarks: Get the Zone Server to travel to based on the User referenced by the UserSessionGUID. Prior to calling this API, you MUST set the Selected Character to connect with using the UserSessionSetSelectedCharacter API for the UserSessionGUID passed into this API. Send in an empty ZoneName or ZoneName set to "GETLASTZONENAME" to use the last zone the Character was on rather than specifying a ZoneName.

member.name: M:OWSPublicAPI.Controllers.UsersController.SetPreferredServerRegion(OWSPublicAPI.Requests.Users.SetPreferredServerRegionRequest)
member.summary: Set the server region this account plays in.
member.remarks: Pins the User behind the UserSessionGUID to one of the regions advertised by api/Servers/List. Zone spin-up and instance reuse then only consider launcher hosts registered in that region, and fail closed (no fallback to another region) when none of them is active.

member.name: M:OWSPublicAPI.Controllers.UsersController.RegisterUser(OWSPublicAPI.DTOs.RegisterUserDTO)
member.summary: Register a new User account by sending FirstName, LastName, Email, and Password.
member.remarks: Register a new User and then Logs the User in and Creates a User Session. member.name: T:OWSPublicAPI.Requests.Users.SetPreferredServerRegionRequest
member.summary: Pins the signed-in account to a server region, which is what routes it to one launcher host.
member.remarks: Called by the login screen when the player presses Enter on the server selector, before characters are fetched. The region is stored on the User rather than the session because the paths that reach GetServerToConnectTo do not all carry a UserSessionGUID (the InstanceManagement twin of that request has no session field at all), while the character name is always present.
